blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine National Police (PNP) urged high-profile fugitive and gaming tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang to turn himself in to authorities, face the charges and prove his innocence, as a fourth arrest warrant was issued against him. “If he really believes he is innocent, this is the best time to turn yourself over, in rather, para po maharap niya yung mga kaso at para mapatunayan na wala talaga siyang kasalanan,” said PNP spokesperson Brig. Gen. Allen Rae Co in a press briefing on Wednesday. (If he truly believes he is innocent, this is the best time for him to surrender […]...
